fingerprint.structure: 2 slides: cover ("tier list of" + a vivid hero image + the big topic word) → filled tier chart (S+ A B C D, a gap with a plus, then F) with a challenge title and a bio CTA
fingerprint.hook: topic tier list cover ('tier list of [topic]') with an eye-catching false-colour hero image; slide 2 adds a challenge title ('prove me wrong') that invites disagreement in the comments
fingerprint.camera_motion: other:tier-chart-card. Designed cards on a flat pale grey-green background (#EDF2EB), no people filmed; the cells carry mixed cut-out icons (photoreal object cut-outs, glossy 3D emoji-style icons and a few flat black glyphs), multiply-flat on the card, no drop shadows
fingerprint.pacing: slideshow, 2 slides. Cover: 3 text lines. Chart: 22 cells, each a cut-out icon with a 1 to 3 word label, plus a tiny tagline under each tier letter
fingerprint.text_overlay: one thin grotesque (closest Helvetica Neue Light / Inter Light), black #111, mostly lowercase (the topic word on the cover is capitalised). Cover: 'tier list of' about 10% of the height, topic word about 9%, sub word about 6%. Chart: title about 6% top-left, cell labels about 2.2% centred under each icon, tier letters about 5.5%, tier taglines about 1.3%
fingerprint.audio: trending song, 'Retake (Slowed)' by gabriawll (not the creator's)
fingerprint.arc: topic reveal → opinionated ranking → the viewer disagrees and comments (an F-tier cell 'your option (comment)' asks for it), then the bio plug
fingerprint.slides_geometry: chart table x 7.6% to 85.4% of the width, letter column 7.6% to 22%; 5 rows from 17.5% to 73.2% of the height (about 11.1% each), a plus sign in the gap, F row 78.9% to 90%; 1.5 px black border lines; 4 cells per row

layers.note: false-colour scan of the topic's core object (a brain), neon blue pink green yellow, white outline
black line drawing (molecule) with round nodes, bottom-left

composition.balance: centred stack, two small corner objects balance the bottom

other.what: a cover card naming the tier list topic
other.why_it_works: the false-colour hero is loud against the quiet grey card, so it stops the scroll; 'tier list of' promises an opinion to argue with
other.fixed: flat pale card, thin black grotesque, one vivid hero cut-out, two small corner objects

layers.note: 5 rows, letter cells filled red #FB0200, orange #FDA13C, light orange #FADC7C, yellow #FFFD68, light green #BDFD85; black hairline grid
a black plus between the main table and the F row

22 cut-outs: photoreal objects (food, cash, trophy, passport, frying pan, glass of water), glossy 3D icons (weather cloud, 3D app tile), black glyphs (game controller, dice, prohibition sign, silhouettes, a big question mark)

composition.balance: table hugs the left with an empty right margin (about 15%)

real, earned, lasts / strong, still earned / solid, mild / neutral, fine / cheap, mostly harmless / absolutely useless / bad practice

product: the creator's own app, plugged three ways: an A-tier cell 'seeing progress (check bio)', the closing line 'check bio instead', and the caption
series: part 2 ('pt2' on the cover, 'little bit of changes from part 1' in the caption)
caption: one casual line about what changed since part 1, the topic name, 'check bio instead', then hashtags
